button.$description: Button component tokens. These sit above semantic tokens — consume these in button CSS, not semantic tokens directly.

color.$description: Primitive color scale. 25 steps per hue (0–1000). Step N has L = N/1000 in OKLCH — perceptually uniform across all hues at the same step. Chroma (C) tapers at extremes to stay within sRGB gamut. Hex values are approximate sRGB-gamut-mapped fallbacks; verify with culori or oklch.com before production. OKLCH values are authoritative. Do not use these directly in components — reference semantic tokens instead.

neutral.$description: Achromatic neutral. C=0 throughout — use for text, surfaces, borders, dividers, shadows.

blue.$description: Blue-indigo hue (H=250). Primary action family. Peak chroma at step 450–500.

red.$description: Red-orange hue (H=22). Destructive action and error family. Peak chroma at step 450–500.

green.$description: Emerald-green hue (H=150). Success family. Peak chroma at step 450–500.

amber.$description: Amber-yellow hue (H=75). Warning family. Peak chroma at step 350–400 (yellow-amber peaks at higher L than other hues).

shadow.$description: Elevation shadow scale. Shadow color uses neutral with alpha; do not hardcode.

space.$description: Spacing scale. Token name = pixel value (space.16 = 16px). Micro tier (1–3) for optical nudges and fine adjustments; grid tier (4+) for layout. Compiled to rem for layout/typography output via SD4 transform. Negative offsets are not in the scale — use calc(-1 * var(--ds-space-N)) at the call site, or define a named component token for recurring structural offsets (e.g., card bleed).

size.$description: Type size scale. These are raw values — reference semantic type tokens in components.

z.$description: Z-index scale. Use only these values — never arbitrary z-index integers.

action.$description: Action semantic tokens — buttons, links, interactive controls. Mode-aware: swap these per data-mode.

feedback.$description: Feedback state semantic tokens — alerts, banners, badges, form states.

focus.$description: Focus ring tokens. Applied to all interactive elements via :focus-visible. Must never be removed — only styled.

palette.$description: Named scheme and mode palettes. CSS remaps public semantic roles to these tokens; raw color values never live in component or composition styles.

surface.$description: Surface semantic tokens. These define what backgrounds exist in the system. Always use these — never raw color scale values.

text.$description: Text color semantic tokens. All text in the system must use one of these roles.
